title: doppeldata check report v1
description:
Generated data measured against the profile it was generated from, by profiling the data with
that profile's histogram edges and value lists frozen.

changes.description:
Columns the data adds, drops or holds as another kind. A changed Arrow type alone is listed
and passes, because a writer may store a column at another width or unit.

expectations.description: The scenario's declared expectations, empty when no scenario applies.

passed.description: Whether every metric and every column change passed.

profile.description: The profile the data was generated from.

scenario.description: The scenario applied to the profile, or null for none.

verified.description: Whether every declared expectation held. True when no scenario declares any.

oneOf.description: The value passes at or below the threshold.
The value passes at or above the threshold.
The profiler's column kind: integer, float, decimal, string, boolean, date, datetime or other.
The Arrow type, such as `int32` becoming `int64`.
More rows than the diff allows fall outside the histogram edges or value list frozen from A.

CheckedData.description: The data that was profiled and measured.

fingerprint.description: The profile's `source_fingerprint` of the files read, or null for an in-memory table.

path.description: The data as the caller named it, such as `s3://bucket/orders/`.

ExpectationResult.description: A scenario's declared expectation and the value the data holds.

FieldChange.description: A field that differs between the two profiles, outside what the metrics measure.

column.description: The column the change is in, or null for a table-level field.

field.description:
An RFC 6901 pointer to the field: in the source profile, or A, for a dropped column, and in
the other profile for every other change.

observed.description: The field's value in the profile of the data checked, or B, and null where it holds none.

passed.description: False when the change fails the check or counts as drift.

source.description: The field's value in the source profile, or A, and null where it holds none.

MetricResult.description: One metric's value for one column, or for the table where `column` is null.

bound.description: Whether `value` passes at or below `threshold`, or at or above it.

metric.description: The metric's name, such as `ks`, as `--thresholds` keys it.

observed.description: The same statistic in the profile of the data checked: B's, in a diff.

source.description: The statistic the metric compares, as the source profile holds it: A's, in a diff.

digest.description: `sha256:` and the hex SHA-256 of the profile's RFC 8785 canonical JSON.

path.description: The profile's path as the caller gave it, or null when it came from memory.

digest.description: `sha256:` and the hex SHA-256 of the scenario's RFC 8785 canonical JSON.
